extName.message: PostCloak — x.comのポストをシークレットウィンドウで開く
extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and on the Chrome Web Store. Deliberately kept in Japanese: this is the default locale, so it is also the store listing name for every locale without its own translation, and the published listing name must not change. The in-product strings below are localized normally.

extDescription.message: x.comのポスト本文を右クリック、またはShift+Altクリックすると、そのポストをシークレットウィンドウで開きます。X Corp.とは無関係の非公式ツールです。
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome and on the Chrome Web Store. Kept in Japanese for the same reason as extName.

menuOpenInIncognito.message: Open this post in an Incognito window (Shift+Alt click)
menuOpenInIncognito.description: Context menu item shown on x.com pages.

errorNoPostFound.message: No post here. Right-click inside a post.
errorNoPostFound.description: Shown when the right-clicked spot does not belong to a post.

errorRetryNeeded.message: Ready now — please try once more.
errorRetryNeeded.description: Shown after the content script had to be re-injected into an already-open tab.

errorDisconnected.message: Lost the connection to the extension. Reload this page.
errorDisconnected.description: Shown when sendMessage throws because the extension context was invalidated.

errorIncognitoUnavailable.message: Could not open an Incognito window. Incognito mode may be turned off in this browser.
